Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: In step 8, WebSurfer incorrectly characterized DFTD as effectively “caused by parasites” and suggested that framing as the best match, conflating transmissible tumor cells with parasitic causation. This contradicts authoritative sources (e.g., Nature Communications) that explicitly state DFTD is a transmissible cancer in which the cancer cell itself is the infectious agent. The misinterpretation could lead to selecting a parasite-based/chronic classification instead of the correct option B (infectious, cell-cycle disease).
